questions.title: Craziest prediction that came true (+3)
questions.correctText:
United will score goals came true but always does

United will finish in single figures came true but they've done that in 19 of the last 20 seasons so not that impressive

Everton will keep the same manager came true, they've done that in 4 of the last 10 seasons so fairly unlikley

fire broke out in JAN 2025 at etihad but none this season
questions.note: "Everton will keep the same manager" - came true and genuinely unlikely. Worth +3.

questions.title: Prita winner
questions.note: Ben took the title after Fred benched Watkins in GW37 - and not one of us predicted him.

questions.title: The Iheanacho Award (biggest blunder)
questions.correctText: Fred benched watkins in week 37, Watkins had scored 3 goals in the previous 2 matches and went on to score 2 more goals in week 37 scoring 15 points. Fred ended up losing his matchup to Ben by 2 points crowning Ben the league winner
questions.note: Fred benched Watkins in GW37; Watkins scored 15, Fred lost his matchup by 2 and handed Ben the title.

questions.title: The Klopp Award (bitchiest excuses)
questions.correctText:
A tough year for Toby who not only failed to get promoted but also fails to get this award, his bitchiest move this season was to try and block transfers in the final week of the season to have a fair shootout against Eoin

But Lucas had the bitchiest outburst of excuses when he plummeted down the table in the busy winter period losing 6 games in a row
questions.note: Lucas's winter meltdown edged Toby's transfer-blocking for the crown.

questions.title: Dark horse player (surprisingly high)
questions.correctText:
Thiago would be the best answer for this scoring 22 goals last season, when it seemed the year before he might not be cut out for the prem

of these answers welbeck is the best shout, the 35 year old scored 126 points last season, had a great run at one point scoring 6 goals in 5 games and was even talked about for england as a kane backup
questions.note: Welbeck, 35, scored 126 pts - best of the answers given.
